title: TypeScript stories earn more points than JavaScript stories
question: Does a story about TypeScript get more points than a story about JavaScript?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about TypeScript gets more points than a story about JavaScript.
expect: If true, points per TypeScript story should be at least 1.5x the points per JavaScript story, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per TypeScript story against points per JavaScript story

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370 and h375, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h300 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a language is not proof the story is about it, and one story can name both.
Both lists are title words only, so stories that never name the language are missed.
This compares points per story. h300 compares how often each is mentioned.
